name: Puchina Lzhi
source: Four close friends accept an invitation from a longtime acquaintance to take part in a "hyper-realistic quest" set in a virtual reality that visualizes the depths of someone's consciousness. Little do they know, however, that the quest is merely a cover for a dangerous experiment... The group will have to learn firsthand just how risky trust can be. Will they make it out alive?
translation: 四名挚友接受了一位老相识的邀请，参加一场设定在虚拟现实中的“超拟真冒险任务”——该系统能够将人类意识的深层世界具象化呈现出来。然而他们浑然不知，这场任务不过是一场危险实验的幌子……四人将亲身领教“信任”究竟伴随着多大的风险。他们最终能活着逃出生天吗？
